genreSection.title: The styles and specialties that define the sound.

items.label: Theatrical
items.title: Musical theatre, show tunes, Broadway-inspired writing, and character-led songs.
items.description: Best for material that needs acting-through-song, dramatic pacing, and vocals that feel like they belong to a character or a scene instead of a neutral take.

items.label: Reimagined Covers
items.title: Genderbent arrangements, Disney-fied renditions, and story-driven reinterpretations.
items.description: Strong for songs that deserve a new perspective, especially female-led tracks adapted into male-key arrangements or contemporary songs transformed into bigger, cinematic performances.

items.label: Pop, Indie, K-pop & J-pop
items.title: Polished melodic vocals for internet-native, emotionally bright, or collaboration-heavy tracks.
items.description: A good fit for hooks, duet parts, harmony-heavy covers, and songs influenced by idol-pop, indie-pop, acoustic rearrangements, or animation-adjacent music culture.

fitSection.title: Bring a real concept and a part worth performing.

items.label: Open To
items.title: Duets, featured vocals, covers, originals, themed projects, and selective promotions.
items.description: Ralskies is open to projects from producers, mixers, animators, vocalists, VTubers, and online creators who want a vocal performance with identity. The strongest projects usually have a demo, references, deadline, and a clear idea of the role.

items.label: Vocal Profile
items.title: Warm, expressive, studio-ready vocals for both contemporary and theatrical styles.
items.description: Best suited for theatrical expression, harmonization, emotional leads, and collaborative arrangements. If you know the exact voice type or target range you need, include it in your pitch so the part can be evaluated properly.

supportSection.title: Request a song or support future covers.
supportSection.description: If you want to hear a specific song from Ralskies or support future music, use the options below. Requests with a clear idea or emotional angle are easier to prioritize.

items.label: Request A Song
items.title: Send a song idea, theme, or concept worth reimagining.
items.description: Best for covers, male-key versions, theatrical reworks, Disney-style reinterpretations, or songs that would fit the voice and style well.

items.label: Support / Donate
items.title: Help fund future covers, collaborations, and recording work.
items.description: Support helps fund future releases, covers, and better production. If you want to back the music directly, Ko-fi is the easiest way to do it.

fanArtSection.eyebrow: Want To Make Art For Ralskies?
fanArtSection.title: Fan art, illustrations, edits, and visual tributes are always appreciated.
fanArtSection.description: If you create art inspired by Ralskies, there is a place for it here too. Whether it is stylized fan art, thumbnails, edits, or other visual work, the support and creativity are genuinely valued.

items.label: What To Send
items.title: Fan art, edits, concepts, posters, or tribute visuals.
items.description: Finished pieces, work-in-progress previews, and stylized concepts are all welcome as long as they are respectful and clearly inspired by the music, persona, or content.

items.label: Where To Share
items.title: Use Discord or the contact form to send your work.
items.description: If you want the best chance of the art being seen, share it through the Discord community or send it directly through the form with links to the artwork.

collabSection.title: Send a clear pitch, request, or project inquiry.
collabSection.description: Use this for singing collaborations, voice acting, promotions, product inquiries, thumbnail art, fan projects, or any proposal with a clear idea and direction.

testimonials.quote: Working with Ralskies means getting more than a clean take. He brings character, phrasing, and intent that immediately makes the part feel more alive.
testimonials.name: Featured Collaborator

testimonials.quote: There is a clear performance instinct behind the voice. Even in collaborative material, the delivery still feels specific instead of generic.
testimonials.name: Creative Peer

testimonials.quote: The strongest thing about the work is that it sounds considered. The arrangement choices and tone always feel like they are serving an idea.
